VBO:0201323.summary: Alert and devoted, Swiss Mountain Dogs share a Swiss farm-working heritage. The Bernese and Greater Swiss are steady companions, while the smaller Appenzeller and Entlebucher tend to be livelier and watchful around strangers. Across these four distinct breeds, historic duties ranged from driving cattle and guarding homesteads to pulling loaded carts.
VBO:0201323.shortDescription: Four Swiss farm breeds with watchful loyalty, from lively cattle herders to the larger dogs that once pulled heavy carts.
